description:
A poetry network with no likes, no ranking and no follower count.

Sign in, pick a pen name, publish. Each poem gets its own page. The front page is everyone's poems, newest first. Nobody is counting.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Read everyone's poems, newest first, each opening on its first stanza
- Open a poet's page to read everything they have written
- Search poems and poets, save the ones you want to read again, and share any poem
- Write and publish your own under a pen name, and edit or delete it later
- Keep stanzas the way you wrote them: a blank line between stanzas, line breaks kept
- Sign in with Apple or with email and password, and use Face ID to sign back in
- Delete your account and every poem in it whenever you want

Reading needs no account. Every poem can be reported, hidden, or its author blocked from the menu on the poem. No ads, no tracking, nothing for sale.
promotionalText: Write a poem, publish it under a pen name, and read everyone else's. No likes, no ranking.
